name: JE_NET_BATCHES
description: JE_NET_BATCHES contains information about netting batches.

columns.name: BATCH_ID
columns.description: Batch identifier.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: AGREEMENT_ID
columns.description: Agreement identifier.

columns.name: BATCH_NAME
columns.description: Name of the netting batch.

columns.name: BATCH_NUMBER
columns.description: Number of the netting batch.

columns.name: REVIEW_NETTING_BATCH_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if the netting batch must be reviewed before settlement.

columns.name: BATCH_CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Currency code of the netting batch.

columns.name: BATCH_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Status of the netting batch.

columns.name: TOTAL_NETTED_AMOUNT
columns.description: Total netted amount.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_DUE_DATE
columns.description: Date up to which all transactions will be selected.

columns.name: SETTLEMENT_DATE
columns.description: Date when netting process will take place.

columns.name: RESPONSE_DATE
columns.description: Date on which a response has to be received from the approver.

columns.name: EXCHANGE_RATE_TYPE
columns.description: Exchange rate type.

columns.name: EXCHANGE_RATE
columns.description: Exchange rate.

columns.name: GL_DATE
columns.description: Accounting date.

columns.name: CHECKRUN_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the payment batch.

columns.name: LEGAL_ENTITY_ID
columns.description: Legal entity identifier.

columns.name: NETTING_GROUP_CODE
columns.description: Determines the netting agreement group used during batch creation. Values are from the lookup Netting Group Type.

columns.name: GENERATE_SETTLEMENT_BU_ID
columns.description: Business Unit specified when the netting settlement is created by the Generate Netting Settlements process.

columns.name: PARENT_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Request identifier of the Generate Netting Settlements process to create the netting settlement.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.
